notes.title: Testers Welcome!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42281110/b64bc7cda6f0c08a14c4224f51e837fbad88b436.png[/img]

Hammerborn VR QA testing

Hey guys, just wanted to roll out the opportunity for early QA/testing.
if you have a Vive, index, or an oculus, please reach out and I will get you a key.
the only thing I ask of testers is that you give me your true impressions of what we
have so far. together, we can make this game amazing!

you can apply on the official Hammerborn discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/PwFPzheddN]Official HBVR Discord[/url]

be aware I've just created it and it may be empty most of the time excluding myself.

Cheers,

Hari,
HareWare Studios
